title: Create a Patch Tuesday maintenance configuration and a tag-driven ring
summary: Azure CLI for one ring: a monthly InGuestPatch window anchored to Patch Tuesday, then a subscription-level dynamic scope that picks machines by tag.
code:
# Ring ProdA: third Tuesday of the month + 4 days, 22:00 W. Europe, 3-hour window
az maintenance configuration create --resource-group rg-patching --resource-name mc-prodA --maintenance-scope InGuestPatch --location westeurope --maintenance-window-start-date-time "2026-11-01 22:00" --maintenance-window-duration "03:00" --maintenance-window-recur-every "Month Third Tuesday Offset4" --maintenance-window-time-zone "W. Europe Standard Time" --reboot-setting IfRequired --extension-properties InGuestPatchMode=User

# Dynamic scope: every Windows and Linux machine tagged PatchRing=ProdA (command is marked experimental)
az maintenance assignment create-or-update-subscription --maintenance-configuration-id <config-id> --name ring-prodA --filter-tags "{PatchRing:[ProdA]}" --filter-tags-operator All --filter-os-types windows linux
notes: Dynamic scopes are evaluated at run time: removing the tag removes the machine from the ring.
